statement: Let f_j=(q^j;q^j)_infinity and define a(N) by f_4^8/(f_1^16 f_2^8)=sum_{N>=0} a(N)q^N in Z[[q]]. Then a(5n) is congruent to 0 modulo 5 for every integer n>=1; equivalently, U_5(f_4^8/(f_1^16 f_2^8)) is congruent to 1 modulo 5.
contribution: A complete modular-form proof of the frozen first line of Conjecture 7.1. The proof constructs a holomorphic weight-52 eta quotient of level 20 and trivial character, verifies all cusp orders, converts the claim to a weight-60 comparison, and certifies that comparison through the exact Sturm bound 180. A bounded 2026-09-07 search found no separate resolution, but no priority claim is made.
